title: The Friend Who Became Successful First

voiceProfile.tense: Retrospective past tense moving through three clear temporal movements
voiceProfile.register: Brutally honest, wry, self-incriminating, ultimately generous

characters.name: Siddharth Rao
characters.description: Freelance UI designer in Bangalore. Competent, steady, but tortured by the velocity of peer comparison.
characters.internalConflict: Wants desperately to celebrate his best friend's fortune, but experiences every round of funding as an indictment of his own worth.

characters.name: Gautam Nair
characters.description: Founder of a fintech payments gateway. Exhausted, generous, slightly isolated by sudden wealth.
characters.significance: The friend whose meteoric ascent creates an unbridgeable social canyon.

motifs: The two rickety plastic chairs in the Koramangala rented terrace room (2016)
The ₹4,800 craft beer bill settled with an imperceptible tap of a metal card
The whiteboard with startup architecture diagrams covered in permanent marker stains
The penthouse housewarming party overlooking the Indiranagar tree canopy
The recognition that envy is grief for an unlived version of oneself
